name: reduce-review-tooling-spawns
title: Reduce review tooling process spawns
description: Cut redundant process spawns on the per-change review path. review-preflight memoizes its base-ref, changed-paths, and documentation-file-list computations once per run in caches reset by runReviewPreflight, and review-scope answers its 378 membership tests with one process rather than roughly 1500 forks, which full-check pays twice.
